text:
maria: Short thread to finalize the DP pilot ops and recruitment flow. Need a pragmatic plan: two staggered cohorts of 10, four-week pilots, clear pass/fail criteria, minimal legal, and an efficient intake. Who owns what?

dev: I can take onboarding/runbook and the lightweight health-check script. Capacity: 6 fully supported partners at once; with templates we can push to ~12. For 20 total we'll stagger by start weeks and have a rotating 2-person ops window. Need to know SSO and data-access requirements up-front.

sam: UX will provide two short templates: a 6-task usability checklist and a 10-prompt prompt-quality set. Recommend weekly 15m sync + recorded demos. Keep partner surveys to 4 questions.

ashok: CS metrics: require 70% weekly active usage and at least one feature used by >=20% of their flows. Blocker response SLA = 48h. All partner issues go into the shared tracker; major blockers escalate to on-call. Offer credits if we miss core SLAs.

juno: Proposed intake form (minimal fields): org name; contact (email + timezone); company size; use-case (1 line); est monthly tokens; data sensitivity (public/internal/reg); sso required Y/N; co-marketing interest Y/N; NDA checkbox; preferred start window. Keep it < 8 fields to avoid drop-off.

maria: Compensation bands idea: Tier 1 (launch partners) = $5k credits + co-marketing; Tier 2 (pilot partners) = 50% off for 3 months; Tier 3 = credits only. Legal: NDA + short pilot terms doc only.

dev: Ops guardrail: any infra/model changes that could affect pilot partners must follow a canary policy. If partner-specific evals show >5% quality regression, pause rollout for impacted partners and trigger incident response. Reserve a small "rescue" capacity pool. Also create an automated weekly eval job per partner.

sam: Feedback loop: weekly automated evals against partner-provided prompts, a per-partner Notion page (latency p50/p95, error rate, quality delta), weekly digest to partner + internal triage thread, and a short free-text field for anecdotes.

ashok: Success checklist proposal: onboarding <=5 business days; latency p50 <200ms; error rate <1%; partner NPS >=8 at week 4; feature adoption >=20% of tracked flows. If any metric misses by week 6, offer remediation or partial credit.

maria: Screening rubric: prioritize realistic production workloads, mix of verticals, at least one regulated-sensitivity partner to validate Private deployment flow, and a balance of company sizes. Also prioritize partners willing to provide an eval prompt set.

juno: Outreach copy draft: 2-3 short sentences, clear CTA to intake form, list of support touchpoints, and flexible start windows. Add a short bullets list of what partners get (credits + support + co-marketing option).

ops-bot: Note: thread linked to project 'dp-pilot-slate'. Deadlines added: onboarding draft Tue COB; UX templates Wed; SLA + comp terms Fri; intake form Mon.

maria: Action items confirmed. We'll reconvene Tue 10am for 30m if drafts are ready. Thanks everyone. :rocket:
